title: Sheetstamp: fill Word & image templates from Excel in bulk
description: Fill Word and image templates with Excel or CSV data and export hundreds of files in one ZIP. Runs fully offline on Windows and Ubuntu.
ogImageAlt: Sheetstamp turns an Excel or CSV file into hundreds of filled Word and image documents
h1: Fill templates. Export hundreds of files.
lead: Excel or CSV into Word and image templates, one ZIP out.
note: Version 0.2.1. The Windows installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn; verify your download with SHA256SUMS.txt.
videoLabel: Demo video: from an Excel file to one ZIP of filled Word contracts, in four steps.
howVideoLabel: Animation: a CSV file, a contract with tags in double braces, the tags matched to the column headers, the values flying into the contract, and four finished contracts.
howD1: Type a tag such as {{full_name}} where a value goes, in the text, a table, a header or a footer. Pick your Excel or CSV file and a template.
howD2: Tags are matched to columns by name, ignoring accents. Each field shows its value from the first row, and a column fills one field. Preview every row, then export one ZIP.
howT3: Or place text on an image
howD3: Type a field name, place it on a background and pick an installed font. Columns fill the fields in order, left to right.
alt1: Template step: a search box, template groups and a list of templates, each showing how many fields match the data columns.
alt2: Match step: all 5 fields matched, with a row-by-row preview of the birthday card.
alt3: Image template editor: text boxes on the card and the properties of the selected box.
installSub: Pick your system. A few minutes, no account.
winStep2: Double-click the file. No administrator rights needed.
winStep3: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”: click More info, then Run anyway.
winVerify: Open PowerShell in the download folder, run the command, and compare it with the matching line in SHA256SUMS.txt.
ubuReq: The .deb package is the main way to install.
ubuStep1: Open a terminal in the download folder and run:
ubuStep2: Open Sheetstamp from the application menu.
ubuStep3: The AppImage on Ubuntu 24.04 also needs libfuse2t64 (sudo apt install libfuse2t64). The .deb does not.
ubuVerify: Run the command in the download folder and compare it with the matching line in SHA256SUMS.txt.
macText: No macOS build yet. macOS will ship once it can be signed and notarized with Apple.
electron: The bundled Electron is security-supported until 27 April 2027; update Sheetstamp before then.
privSub: Your data never leaves it. No account needed.
priv1D: Sheetstamp runs offline and sends your data nowhere.
priv2D: No statistics are collected and no sign-in is needed.
priv3D: “Check for updates” only opens this page in your browser.
